reading.passage: In an increasingly interconnected world, understanding học tập suốt đời is essential for high school graduates. Recent studies demonstrate that lifelong learning plays a transformative role in driving sustainable progress. Educational institutions worldwide are adapting curricula to equip learners with competencies relevant to lifelong learning.
